svg.title: A commanded restart from A to B
svg.desc: The vehicle runs configuration A and the station is matched with it. The station arms and initiates a restart to B. A datum the vehicle sent before taking the restart arrives before the beacon that carries the restart flag, so it is read with A. A START_NODE the station sent before hearing that beacon reaches a vehicle that has taken the restart, so it is not acted on, and its refusal is dropped and counted on the ground. The flagged beacon ends the match, and the station throws away commands it built with A. The new start loads B and beacons B with the flag set. The operator loads B and sends CONNECT with B, which matches, so the vehicle clears the flag and opens the downlink. The station drops anything queued from before, becomes matched, and reads and commands with B.

text.style: font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold

svg.text: A commanded restart from A to B

text.style: font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px

svg.text: Arrowhead: read or acted on. Cross: dropped and counted, or not acted on. The words at each end say which.
